bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to taxation; local government aid; providing base year formula aid to the city of Baldwin.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+BASE YEAR FORMULA AID FOR THE CITY OF BALDWIN. +]

[+For the calculation under Minnesota Statutes, section 477A.013, subdivisions 8 and 9, for aids payable in 2026, the city of Baldwin's aid for 2025, used in calculating aid payable in 2026, is deemed to be equal to $....... multiplied by the city's population. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective for aids payable in 2026 only. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to taxation; local government aid; providing base year formula aid to the city of Baldwin.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. BASE YEAR FORMULA AID FOR THE CITY OF BALDWIN.

For the calculation under Minnesota Statutes, section 477A.013, subdivisions 8 and 9, for aids payable in 2026, the city of Baldwin's aid for 2025, used in calculating aid payable in 2026, is deemed to be equal to $....... multiplied by the city's population.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective for aids payable in 2026 only.
